bank_method.source: CA14_Dietrich_B class 2 terrestrial ground; same survey as bathymetry
bank_method.method: 2 m mean XYZ ground bins; linear TIN; triangle edge <=8 m; nearest ground-bin centroid <=3 m; 40 m tile halo
bank_method.extent: Within 75 m of mapped river or 30 m of class 14 return footprint
bank_method.water_mask: Exclude 2 m cells containing class 9,14,15 and 2 m margin; water footprint is incomplete, not a wetted polygon
bank_method.warning: Provisional bank/terrain surface, not bathymetry or a filled channel. Retain separately from candidate bed.

bank_recovery_qa.method: Original 2 m class-2 bank algorithm, 40 m halo, class9/14/15 water exclusion plus 2 m margin. Only new supported cells within 100 m of corrected route in recovered bed tiles added. No water gaps filled.

quality_method.source_classes: 14 candidate bed; 15 candidate water surface; interpretations provisional

classes.1: Coherent and below estimated surface by more than tolerance; provisional bed
classes.2: Within surface tolerance: shallow bed or surface return, unresolved
classes.3: Above estimated surface by more than tolerance
classes.4: Coherent candidate bed, local surface check unavailable
classes.5: Insufficient local 3D support (isolated or steep/rough), unresolved

quality_method.roughness_warning: Screen changes sampled depths and coverage. Near-surface/shallow returns excluded rather than declared erroneous. Not a calibrated classifier or field validation.

recovery_qa.method: Same original class-14 TIN and raw-point PCA algorithms; only newly recovered bed cells added. Existing valid values are unchanged. Full source tiles already present locally. Bank extension is documented separately.

route_qa.method: 4 m least-cost path through lidar water/bed footprints (classes 9/14/15); 5 km approximate NHD branch anchors; 10 m smoothing capped at 5 m displacement; loops removed
route_qa.warning: Water-return footprint is incomplete and class interpretation provisional. Supported means lidar-aligned, not a surveyed thalweg or independently validated channel center. Ambiguous/sparse spans remain flagged.

assignment_qa.note: Bed and all PCA neighborhoods rebuilt from screened points. Geometry remains route v2. Original v2 files preserved separately. Quality areas are fractions of original supported candidate bed, not full channel.
